description: Android Fragment class for the home screen of a driver app, managing UI elements, map view, weather updates, and job count.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment for the home screen, displaying user info, jobs, weather, and map.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up map, and schedules location updates.

methods.name: numberOfJobs
methods.description: Reads and counts jobs from internal storage JSON file.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns current date formatted as 'Day dd Month'.

methods.name: scheduleUpdateLocation
methods.description: Schedules periodic weather updates and job count refresh.

methods.name: getWeather
methods.description: Fetches and displays weather information from stored JSON.

methods.name: focusMap
methods.description: Zooms map to current location or default zoom.

methods.name: onMapReady
methods.description: Initializes map settings and camera position.

methods.name: onLowMemory
methods.description: Handles low memory condition for map view.
